The observation data is filtered to observations within the study extent and that meet certain requirements. The data is saved as a CSV and RDS.

# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: debug-dependencies
#| include: false
# If facing issues with flextable::autofit(), run this block to fix
# dependencies with installation of the flextable and systemfonts packages

remove.packages("flextable")
remove.packages("systemfonts")

install.packages("flextable", dependencies = T)
install.packages("systemfonts")

library(flextable)
library(systemfonts)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, officer, flextable, sf)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L0/004_clean_raw_EPT.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
```

# Read data

## Shapefile data
```{r}
#| label: read-raw-sf-data
# Read Eastern USA L1 ecoregion shapefile
ETF_sf <- read_sf(here(
  L0_data_dir,
  "000a_na_cec_eco_l1",
  "NA_CEC_Eco_Level1.shp"
)) |>
  filter(NA_L1NAME == "EASTERN TEMPERATE FORESTS") |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326) |> # Ensures WGS84
  st_make_valid()

# Read raw EPT in ETF shapefile
raw_ETF_EPT_sf <- read_sf(here(
  L0_data_dir,
  "003_raw_ETF_EPT_obs_shp",
  "003_raw_ETF_EPT_obs.shp"
))
raw_ETF_EPT_df <- as.data.frame(raw_ETF_EPT_sf)
```

**Visualize data**

```{r}
#| label: viz-ETF-ept-data
# Visualize EPT points in the ETF
plot(
  st_geometry(ETF_sf),
  main = "Eastern USA L1 Ecoregion (US EPA) and iNaturalist EPT observations"
)
plot(
  st_geometry(raw_ETF_EPT_sf),
  col = "blue",
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 16,
  cex = 1
)

rm(raw_ETF_EPT_sf, ETF_sf)
```

## Observation data

```{r}
#| label: read-raw-obs-data
# Read raw observation data
raw_ETF_EPT <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "002a_raw_EPT_obs.csv")) |>
  semi_join(raw_ETF_EPT_df, by = "id") |> # Only keep EPT obs in the ETF
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) # Remove dupes

rm(raw_ETF_EPT_df)
```

# Data exploration

Explore filters

* observation status
* dates
* licenses
* geolocation accuracy


**examine observation status**

**examine dates**

Use `observed_on` rather than `created_at` for date filtering because `created_at` is when the obs was uploaded, not when it was observed. Note iNat start date is 2008.

* 365 obs without a date
* 467 obs outside of 2000 to 2025

```{r}
#| label: examine-dates
dates <- raw_ETF_EPT |>
  select(
    id,
    observed_on,
    created_at,
    created_at_details.date,
    observed_on_details.date,
    observed_on_details.day,
    observed_on_details.month,
    observed_on_details.hour,
    observed_on_details.year,
    observed_on_details.week,
    created_at_details.day,
    created_at_details.month,
    created_at_details.hour,
    created_at_details.year,
    created_at_details.week
  )


# 365 obs without a date
dates |> filter(is.na(observed_on)) |> count()

# 467 obs outside of 2000-2025
dates |> filter(!between(observed_on_details.year, 2000, 2025)) |> count()


# Look at differences when observations were uploaded to iNat vs. when they were actually observed in the wild
dates <- dates |>
  mutate(date_diff = as.numeric(as.Date(created_at) - as.Date(observed_on))) |>
  relocate(date_diff, .after = id)

plot(dates$created_at_details.date, dates$date_diff)
plot(dates$observed_on_details.date, dates$date_diff)
plot(dates$observed_on_details.date, dates$created_at_details.date)

rm(dates)
```

**examine geolocation accuracy**

```{r}
#| label: examine-geo-acc
geo <- raw_ETF_EPT |>
  select(
    id,
    taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy, # can be overrided by taxon_geoprivacy or geoprivacy
    taxon_geoprivacy,
    geoprivacy,
    out_of_range,
    location,
    obscured,
    public_positional_accuracy,
    positional_accuracy,
    context_user_geoprivacy,
    preferences.auto_obscuration, # related to user preferences, not obs
    place_guess,
    map_scale,
    mappable
  )

# No missing coordinates; observations with missing locations were already
# removed in the `002_combine_raw_EPT.qmd` script
geo |> filter(is.na(location)) |> count()


# --- Look at geoprivacy ---

# 110 obs with taxon-related geoprivacy
geo |> filter(taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy == "obscured") |> count()
geo |> filter(taxon_geoprivacy == "obscured") |> count()

# 16,720 obs with obscured coordinates, creating coordinates with a positional
# accuracy greater than ~26k meters
geo |> filter(geoprivacy == "obscured") |> count()
geo |> filter(geoprivacy == "private") |> count()

# Geoprivacy columns are either obscured, private, open, or NA.
# "Obscured" points are a random point within a 0.2*0.2 degree cell of the
# original observation point. NA usually indicates that the observation
# geoprivacy is open, or that another geoprivacy column needs to be referenced
# for the correct geoprivacy.
# Filters out 16,781 obs relating to geoprivacy
filtered_geo <- geo |>
  filter(geoprivacy != "obscured" | is.na(geoprivacy) | geoprivacy == "open") |>
  filter(
    taxon_geoprivacy != "obscured" |
      is.na(taxon_geoprivacy) |
      taxon_geoprivacy == "open"
  ) |>
  filter(
    (taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy == "obscured" &
      taxon_geoprivacy == "open") |
      is.na(taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy) |
      taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy == "open"
  ) |>
  filter(obscured == F)


# taxon geoprivacy
# notice 77 obs are obscured, due to recognized conservation status
# notice 3,294 are open and 195,044 are NA due to unknown conservation status
#https://help.inaturalist.org/en/support/solutions/articles/151000169938-what-is-geoprivacy-what-does-it-mean-for-an-observation-to-be-obscured-
geo |>
  group_by(taxon_geoprivacy) |>
  tally(sort = TRUE) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit()


# --- Look at positional accuracy ---

# Only 1 obs with differences in positional accuracy and public_positional_accuracy
# Note sure why the difference exists, but will remove this obs to avoid issues
filtered_geo |>
  filter(public_positional_accuracy != positional_accuracy) |>
  count()

# 36,459 obs missing accuracy
# While NA accuracies can be due to devices not sharing location data with
# iNaturalist (e.g., some cameras or Android devices don't geotag images or
# location sharing permissions must be explicitly set up), I removed them to
# avoid spatial imprecision.
filtered_geo |> filter(is.na(positional_accuracy)) |> count()

# Remove bad accuracies
filtered_geo_upd1 <- filtered_geo |>
  filter(public_positional_accuracy == positional_accuracy) |>
  filter(!is.na(positional_accuracy))

# - Determine positional accuracy filter

# First look at accuracy; 145,174 obs
filtered_geo_upd1 |> ggplot(aes(x = positional_accuracy)) + geom_boxplot()
count(filtered_geo_upd1) # all accuracy

# 500m accuracy or less; 129,489 obs
filtered_geo_upd2 <- filtered_geo_upd1 |>
  filter(positional_accuracy < 500)
filtered_geo_upd2 |> ggplot(aes(x = positional_accuracy)) + geom_boxplot()
count(filtered_geo_upd2) # < 500m accuracy

# 100m accuracy or less; ; 108,180 obs
filtered_geo_upd3 <- filtered_geo_upd1 |>
  filter(positional_accuracy < 100) # Only keep accuracy of 100m
filtered_geo_upd3 |> ggplot(aes(x = positional_accuracy)) + geom_boxplot()
count(filtered_geo_upd3) # < 100m accuracy


rm(geo, filtered_geo, filtered_geo_upd1, filtered_geo_upd2, filtered_geo_upd3)
```



# Clean data

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
clean_ETF_EPT <- raw_ETF_EPT |>
  # Already filtered to include only ETF obs
  filter(quality_grade != "casual") |> # Remove casual obs
  filter(!is.na(observed_on)) |> # Remove missing dates
  filter(between(observed_on_details.year, 2000, 2025)) |> # Dates 2000-2025
  filter(license_code %in% c("cc-by", "cc-by-nc", "cc0")) |> # CC Licenses
  # --Only keep observations with unobscured geoprivacy
  filter(geoprivacy != "obscured" | is.na(geoprivacy) | geoprivacy == "open") |>
  filter(
    taxon_geoprivacy != "obscured" |
      is.na(taxon_geoprivacy) |
      taxon_geoprivacy == "open"
  ) |>
  filter(
    (taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy == "obscured" &
      taxon_geoprivacy == "open") |
      is.na(taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy) |
      taxon.conservation_status.geoprivacy == "open"
  ) |>
  filter(obscured == F) |>
  filter(positional_accuracy < 100) # Only keep accuracy of <100m
```


# Summarize clean data

```{r}
#| label: summarize-clean-data
# All EPT obs
clean_EPT_export <- clean_ETF_EPT |>
  select(id, location, taxon.ancestry, taxon.name) |>
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(str_extract(location, "^[^,]+")),
    long = as.numeric(str_extract(location, "[^,]+$")),
  ) |>
  select(-location)
```


# Export data

```{r}
#| label: export-data
# Save all occurrence data
clean_EPT_export |>
  select(id, lat, long, taxon.name) |>
  write_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "004_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.csv"))
```
